selection_rule: Use first positive-volume common daily candle from public listing-start sample, then entire continuous intersection through original LP last timestamp; exclude zero-volume initialization. First sample positive day is 2021-06-15. No return-based window selection.
join_rule: as-of latest fully CLOSED UTC daily candle; no use of current day's close; maximum lag less than 24h plus close trade staleness not identified by daily OHLC; never fill missing/zero-volume days with 1
limitations: First positive-volume listing day may partial; daily marks are conditional historical valuation only, not executable exact same-block USD prices; non-contemporaneous two coin closes; no pool-derived USD anchor.
